δειρὴν: δειρή — neck, throat; fem. acc. sg., epic -ὴν (= Attic δέρην)

πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντοσ: πάντοσε — in every direction, on every side; adv., elided (πάντοσ’ = πάντοσε)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ)
πέρ: περ — at least, even; enclitic restrictive/intensive particle, accented before the enclitic μοι: τιμήν πέρ ’honour at least’ · also intensive after a relative adj., accented before the enclitic τε: οἷός πέρ τε ’just such as’ · also intensive after a relative pronoun, accented before the enclitic φασι: ’whom indeed’ · also intensive after ὅτε, accented before τε: ’just when’ · also intensive after εἰ, accented before the enclitic τε: ’if indeed’ (εἴ πέρ τε νοήσῃ ’if a man indeed notices’)
πέρι: περί — about, over, for; prep. + gen. with anastrophe (accent thrown back, after its noun): ’over, about’ · also adv. of degree, with a genitive of the person: ’beyond others, exceedingly’ (οὗ πέρι … κραδίη ’whose heart beyond others’)
πίσυνοι: πίσυνος — trusting, relying on (+ dat.); adj., masc. nom. pl.
παμφαίνων: παμφαίνω — shine brightly, gleam; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’gleaming’
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’)
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην … πατρίδα γαῖαν ’dear native land’)
πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the space traversed: ’over the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the plain’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’)
πλήξιππον: πληξίππος — horse-lashing, driving horses with the whip; masc. acc. sg., epithet of Menestheus · also masc. acc. sg., epithet of Orestes
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολεμίζειν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf.: πόλεμον πολεμίζειν ’to wage war’
πολλὰς: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. pl., accent grave mid-clause
πολυχρύσοιο: πολύχρυσος — rich in gold; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
προϊάψειν: προϊάπτω — send forth, dispatch (to Hades); fut. inf. act., in indirect speech after ἐφάμην: ’that I would send’
πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’) · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρό τε παίδων ’for the children’)
πρώτοισι: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’the foremost’
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πτύχας: πτύξ — fold, layer (of hide); also a mountain-fold, the recesses of a mountain’s flank; fem. acc. pl.
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόλεμος: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg.
πῖπτε: πίπτω — fall; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπιπτε)
σίτου: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the thing one takes one’s fill of
σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σκιόεντα: σκιόεις — shadowy, shady; neut. nom./acc. pl.
στήθεσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl.
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); fem. acc. pl.
στεροπὴ: στεροπή — lightning, flash; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀστραπή)
στᾶσ: ἵστημι — set; aor. ἔστην, intrans., take one’s stand; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (στᾶσ’ = στᾶσα): ’having taken her stand’
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’breast’ (Ἥρῃ … στῆθος ’Hera’s breast’)
σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them, their’ or acc. σφε ’them’
σφι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. σφι: ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σχέθε: ἔχω — hold, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg., thematic aorist with epic -θ- (σχεθ-), unaugmented (= ἔσχε)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’)
τέρας: τέρας — sign, portent, marvel; neut. acc. sg.: ’portent’ · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition to a noun: ’a portent’
τέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; plpf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτέτυκτο): ’had been made’ · also plpf. pass. 3 sg. as a copula with a predicate adj.: ’was, had come to be (the best)’
τίετο: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐτίετο): ’was honoured’
ταχείης: ταχύς — swift, fleet; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -είης (= Attic -είας)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελαμωνιάδαο: Τελαμωνιάδης — son of Telamon, i.e. Ajax; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
τελαμὼν: τελαμών — broad strap, shield-strap, baldric; masc. nom. sg.
τετραφάληρον: τετραφάληρος — with four φάλοι (crest-holders or plates; exact sense uncertain); fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with κυνέην
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. τοί (= Attic οἱ), used as a relative: ’who’ · also τοί = τοι, encl. dat. of σύ: ’to you’ (κασίγνητος δέ τοί εἰμι ’I am your brother’)
τοὔνεκά: τοὔνεκα (τοῦ + ἕνεκα, crasis) — therefore, for that reason; adv., accented before the enclitic οἱ · also accented before the enclitic μιν (τοὔνεκά μιν κάλεον ’for that reason they called him’) · also accented before the enclitic τοι: ’for that reason (I tell you)’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’) · also masc. dat. pl. with a noun, demonstrative: ’these’ (τοῖς ἵπποισιν ’these horses’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same form)
τροίην: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. (Attic Τροία)
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’until’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., also + gen.: ’far from’
τῆμος: τῆμος — then, at that time; correlative temporal adv. answering ἦμος ’when’
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’) · also fem. gen. sg., of the person heard after ἔκλυεν: ’her’ · also fem. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (φιλότητος … τῆς ’that friendship’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
υἷε: υἱός — son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’
φάλαγγας: φάλαγξ — line of battle, battle-line, phalanx; fem. acc. pl.
φέβοντο: φέβομαι — flee, take flight; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., unaugmented (= ἐφέβοντο)
φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., of wish: ’may she carry’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to bring’
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φόβοιο: φόβος — flight, panic; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), objective gen. after μήστωρε: ’of flight’
φόβος: Φόβος — Terror, Rout personified (cf. φόβος ’flight, fear’); masc. nom. sg.
φόως: φῶς (φάος) — light; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φῶς)
χαλκοῦ: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg.: πλεῖαι χαλκοῦ ’full of bronze’
χαλκόν: χαλκός — bronze; masc. acc. sg., of the armour, object of ταρβήσας
χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. pl., dependent on a noun: μένος χειρῶν ’the might of hands’ · also fem. gen. pl., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the hands’ (ἐκ … χειρῶν ’out of the hands’) · also fem. gen. pl., object of ἅπτομαι (gen. of the part touched): χειρῶν ἁψάσθην ’took hold of his hands’
χραισμεῖν: χραισμέω — ward off, avail, help (+ dat.); aor. inf. act.: ’to help, to avail’
χρυσέοισιν: χρύσεος — golden; masc. dat. pl., epic uncontracted -έοισιν (= Attic χρυσοῖς)
χρυσοῖο: χρυσός — gold; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
χρύσειοι: χρύσεος — golden; adj., masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic χρυσοῖ)
ἀέξετο: ἀέξω — make grow, increase; pass. grow; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠέξετο): ’was growing’
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαυοῦ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Τυδέος · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Λαομέδοντος: ’noble (Laomedon)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Πηλεΐωνος: ’noble (son of Peleus)’
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address
ἀκάμαντ: Ἀκάμας — Acamas, a Thracian leader, son of Eussorus; masc. acc. sg., elided (Ἀκάμαντ’ = Ἀκάμαντα)
ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to one another’
ἀμφίφαλον: ἀμφίφαλος — with a φάλος (crest-holder) on each side, two-ridged; fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with κυνέην
ἀμφοτέρωσε: ἀμφοτέρωσε — to both sides, both ways; adv. (-σε suffix ’toward’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj. of two endings, acc. sg. (masc./fem.) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg. · also + dat., ’to meet, against’ (τῇ δ’ ἀντίος ’to meet her’)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’)
ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with the ending -α: ’took away’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀραρυίας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together; perf. part. fem. acc. pl., epic reduplicated -υῖα, no Attic prose equivalent: ’fitted’
ἀργείοισι: Ἀργεῖοι — Argives, Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀργυρέοισιν: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic ἀργυροῖς), agreeing with ἐπισφυρίοις · also agreeing with ἱμᾶσιν: ’(straps) of silver’
ἀργύρεον: ἀργύρεος — silver, of silver; adj., neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυροῦν), agreeing with a neuter noun
ἀργύρεος: ἀργύρεος — silver, made of silver; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοῖσιν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄντιφος: Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, son of Thessalus, a leader from Cos; masc. nom. sg. · also Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, a Maeonian leader, son of Talaemenes; masc. nom. sg. · also Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, a son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἄνωγεν: ἄνωγα — order, bid; perf. with present force, 3 sg. ἄνωγεν also in past sense (= ἠνώγει): ’ordered’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρουραν: ἄρουρα — tilled land, ploughland, earth; fem. acc. sg.
ἄσβεστος: ἄσβεστος — unquenchable, unceasing; masc. nom. sg.
ἄϊδι: Ἅιδης (epic also Ἄϊς) — Hades, god of the dead; dat. sg. of Ἄϊς
ἅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’; not the possessive
ἐΐσας: ἐΐσος (ἔΐσος) — equal, even, balanced (of ships, sense uncertain); fem. acc. pl., epic · also of mares, ’balanced, level’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ἐΐσας ’balanced along the back’)
ἐΐσην: ἐΐσος — equal, balanced; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀσπίδα: ’balanced, equal on all sides’
ἐβόησεν: βοάω — shout, cry out; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’shouted’
ἐδύσετο: δύω — enter, sink into; put on (armour, + acc.); aor. mid. 3 sg., epic ἐδύσετο (= Attic ἐδύσατο)
ἐείκοσι: εἴκοσι — twenty; numeral, indeclinable, epic prothetic ἐ- (ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλάφοιο: ἔλαφος — deer, hind; masc./fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναντίοι: ἐναντίος — opposite, facing; masc. nom. pl.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’)
ἐπέτελλεν: ἐπιτέλλω — command, charge, enjoin; impf. 3 sg. act. (augment inside the compound), + dat. + inf.: ’charged’
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπιείκελον: ἐπιείκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., epic
ἐπισφυρίοις: ἐπισφύριον — ankle-piece, ankle-clasp (of a greave); neut. dat. pl.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain)
ἐρυκέμεν: ἐρύκω — hold back, keep off; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐρύκειν): ’to hold back’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσύλα: συλάω — strip off, take away; impf. 3 sg.: ’stripped off’
ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑνὶ: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc./neut. dat. sg. ἑνί
ἑνὸς: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. gen. sg.
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἑῷ: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-pers. reflexive possessive adj., masc. dat. sg.: ’her own’
ἔβαλ: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔβαλ’ = ἔβαλε): ’struck, hit’
ἔδυ: δύω — go in, sink down; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist ἔδυ): ’went down into’
ἔδυνε: δύνω (by-form of δύω) — put on, enter; impf. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’put on’
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔλυσεν: λύω — loosen, unstring; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’loosened’
ἔμβαλ: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, put into; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔμβαλ’ = ἔμβαλε), + acc. and dat.: ’put into’
ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was about to’
ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
ἔνευεν: νεύω — nod; impf. 3 sg. with ν-movable (= Attic ἔνευε): ’nodded’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔριδα: ἔρις — strife, rivalry, contest; fem. acc. sg.
ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative -σκ- form: ’was, used to be’
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔσχατα: ἔσχατος — farthest, outermost; neut. acc. pl. used as an adverb: ’at the farthest end’
ἔχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχεν): ’held’ · also of a feeling, ’seized, gripped’ (θάμβος … ἔχεν ’wonder held (them)’)
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκηλοι: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. pl.
ἕκτορά: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic περ
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἕλετ: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (ἕλετ’ = ἕλετο = εἵλετο)
ἕτεροι: ἕτερος — the other, the other of two, a second party; masc. nom. pl.: ’others’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠνορέῃ: ἠνορέη — manliness, courage; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic ἀνδρεία)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also ἠώς — morning, dawn (the time of day, not the goddess); fem. nom. sg.: ’it was morning’ (ἠὼς ἦν)
ἡνιόχῳ: ἡνίοχος — charioteer; masc. dat. sg., with ὑπό: ’under the charioteer’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἤϋσε: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ἤϋσε): ’shouted’
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥπτετο: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of, reach; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’took hold, reached its mark’, of missiles
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj. (epic)
ἧκεν: ἵημι — send, hurl, let fly; aor. 3 sg. (ἧκα), ν-movable: ’hurled’
ἧχι: ἧχι — where; epic relative adv. (= Attic οὗ)
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἰφθίμους: ἴφθιμος — stout, mighty; masc. acc. pl.
ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. acc. sg. (the neut. has the same spelling)
ἱκάνει: ἱκάνω — come, arrive, reach; pres. 3 sg.
ἱππῆες: ἱππεύς — horseman, charioteer; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
ἴδης: Ἴδη — Mount Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἴδης)
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ἵμερος: ἵμερος — longing, desire; masc. nom. sg.
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ἵππουριν: ἵππουρις — with a horsehair plume; adj., fem. acc. sg.
ὀδοῦσιν: ὀδούς — tooth; masc. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with the teeth’
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic Ὀδυσσῆος (double σ, metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; neut. acc. sg.: ’a small (prize)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbially: ’little’ (ὀλίγον … ἐοικότα ’little like’)
ὀλοοῖο: ὀλοός — destructive, baneful; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὀξέα: ὀξύς — sharp, keen, shrill; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’shrilly’ · also neut. acc. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’sharp’ (ὀξέα δοῦρα ’sharp spears’)
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄεσσι: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic οἰσί)
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐπήρκεσε
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’)
ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg. · also Ὕλη — Hyle, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’)
ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’roused’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
